name: Respond to severe bleeding
short_description: Recognise severe external bleeding, summon help, and apply firm direct pressure using layperson first aid.
self_assessment: I can respond to severe external bleeding without help until emergency support takes over.
description: Recognise severe external bleeding, summon help, and apply firm direct pressure using layperson first aid. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Apply sustained direct pressure while help is called
safety_note: Severe bleeding is life-threatening; call emergency help, use a barrier when available, apply firm pressure, and do not remove embedded objects.
